usedFor: Resemble.ai makes synthetic voices, and “Create Project” opens a project to hold them.

bestTemplate.name: “New Meeting” in Google Meet, then “Create Project” in Resemble.ai
bestTemplate.why: A new meeting can open a voice project, so work starts in one place.

watchOut: “Create Project” makes a project each time it runs, so test with one event before a busy trigger.
